text:
mina: Announcing GA: Hosted Streaming in APAC (Singapore region) + mosaic-asiaplus model optimized for low-latency regional inference. Docs + Compliance note are live. :rocket:
raj: Fantastic. Any customer-facing changes besides the new regional endpoint?
mina: Two things: 1) a regional endpoint (ap-sg) with data residency for requests to stay in-region; 2) default routing will prefer ap-sg for APAC customers when applicable. No billing changes.
devx: Migration snippet for clients (JS websocket):
```
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://hosted.ap-sg.redwood.ai/stream/v1');
ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'open', model: 'mosaic-asiaplus-v1', multiplex: true }));
// stream frames follow...
```
partners-team: We'll email enterprise partners in APAC with next steps and offer 1:1 migration calls this week.
infra-bot: Rollout plan: 10% APAC traffic -> 50% (6h) -> 100% (24h). We'll enable regional autoscaling and warm nodes prior to 50% bump.
sre-lead: Watchlist during rollout: connection churn, TLS session reuse, and new CDN edge routing. Pager if websocket error rate >1.5% for 10m or CPU on ap-sg pool >80% for 5m.
raj: Any changes to auth or KMS?
mina: Customers using Redwood Private with KMS can now opt for ap-sg KMS endpoints. Hosted API keys work the same. We'll add a region flag to the console and API: region: 'ap-sg'.
devx: Also added a small quality note: mosaic-asiaplus favors shorter prefix latencies; you may see slightly different auto-batching behavior vs global-mosaic. We documented the perf tradeoffs.
infra-bot: Canary note: if your SDKs still point at global endpoints we'll auto-route for 30 days, then surface opt-in guidance. Deprecation warnings for using legacy ap-legacy host start in 14 days.
partners-team: Scheduling two office hours for APAC customers tomorrow and Friday (APAC friendly times).
mina: Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/apac-streaming - includes perf table, migration guide, and compliance FAQ. If you want walk-throughs DM me or tag @devx. Thanks to eng-runtime, infra, and devex for the quick turn. :tada:
